errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the line style for the 'БРИКС' series as a short-dashed line ('пунктирно-къса'), when the legend and chart show a dash-dot line.
The description incorrectly identifies the line style for the 'съседни държави' (Neighboring countries) series as a solid line ('плътна'), when the legend and chart show a dashed line.

errors.text_span: Дялът на ОИСР (с ЕС) започва около 80%
errors.evidence: In the 'Внос' (Imports) section, the starting value for the 'ОИСР' line in 2004 is approximately 85%, not 80% as stated.
In the 'Внос' (Imports) section, the value for 'БРИКС' in 2019 is approximately 10%, not 15%.

In the 'Внос' (Imports) section, the line for 'Съседните държави' (Neighboring countries) from 2010 onwards stays in a narrow range between approximately 9% and 11%. The stated range of 10-15% is too wide and inaccurate at the upper end.
In the 'Износ' (Exports) section, the value for 'ЕС' (EC) in 2006 is approximately 61%, not 55%.

errors.text_span: има леко намаление до около 80% през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: In the 'Износ' (Exports) section, the minimum for the 'ОИСР' line occurs around 2012 at approximately 79%, not in 2015 at 80%. The year and value of the trough are both incorrect.
In the 'Износ' (Exports) section, the final value for 'ОИСР' in 2019 is approximately 79%, not 85%.
In the 'Износ' (Exports) section, the peak value for 'БРИКС' in 2008 is approximately 7%, not 10%.
In the 'Износ' (Exports) section, the line for 'Съседни държави' (Neighboring countries) is at approximately 16% in 2010 and its lowest point is around 15% in 2009, not 10% in 2010.
